newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Swedish Oct unemployment seen at 8.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Swedish Oct unemployment seen at 8.0 pct.

text.p: Swedish unemployment is expected to fall to 8.0 percent in October from 8.3 percent in September, a Reuter poll of 14 analysts showed on Friday.
The forecasts ranged between 7.7 percent and 8.3 percent. The figure for October 1995 was 7.6 percent.
Average unemployment is forecast at 7.9 percent for the year, with a forecast range of 7.7 percent to 8.2 percent.
Statistics Sweden is due to publish its October jobless date at 1200 GMT on November 8.

Sources: Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, HSBC Midland, Lehman Brothers, Merrill Lynch, Nordbanken, PaineWebber, S-E-Banken, Tranferator, Union Bank of Switzerland, Unibank.
